name: AI
audience: Product leaders building with AI: model and agent launches, research that changes what's possible, and the money and policy that change what gets funded.
brief: Pick only items that change what a product leader can build, buy, or should worry about. Prefer shipped over announced, primary sources over coverage. Skip incremental benchmark bumps, minor funding rounds under $500M unless strategically telling, and opinion pieces.
sources: Lab and company blogs: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google/DeepMind, Meta AI, Microsoft, Apple, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen
Research: arXiv cs.AI/cs.CL trending, METR, Epoch AI
Developer signal: Hacker News front page, GitHub trending, Hugging Face trending
Coverage for cross-checks: TechCrunch, The Verge, Reuters, Bloomberg, The Information, Scientific American
Trackers: release trackers and model price/benchmark pages (verify against the vendor)
pmLens: Why it matters for a product leader building AI products in a regulated, high-volume consumer business.

name: Startups
audience: Product leaders and founders watching where startup money goes: big rounds, valuations, shutdowns, M&A and IPOs, in India and globally.
brief: Pick funding, M&A, IPO and shutdown news that shows where capital and talent are moving. Prefer rounds of $100M+ or strategically telling smaller ones, India ecosystem shifts, and patterns across several deals over single press releases. Skip routine seed rounds and promotional coverage.
sources: Inc42, Entrackr, YourStory, The Ken, Mint (India)
TechCrunch, Crunchbase News, Bloomberg, Reuters, The Information (global)
Weekly funding trackers (verify against the company)
pmLens: What it signals about where product opportunities, competition and hiring are heading.

name: Fintech
audience: Product leaders in fintech, payments, lending and insurance: launches, licences, regulation and the money behind them.
brief: Pick news that changes what fintech products can do or must comply with: new licences and charters, regulator moves (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, NPCI, FCA, MAS, US regulators), payment-rail changes, agentic payments, and large raises. No stock tips, price targets or buy/sell views.
sources: Regulator sites and circulars (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, NPCI, FCA, MAS)
FinTech Futures, Finextra, The Paypers, Fintech Singapore, Entrackr, Inc42
pmLens: What it changes for a product leader building payments, lending or insurance products: compliance, partnerships, UX and unit economics.
